summary.title: Garden-path interaction
summary.interpretation: Positive: the missing-comma cost is larger after the ambiguous verb.

summary.title: Agreement preference
summary.interpretation: Positive: the grammatical verb is preferred, averaged across all four contexts.

summary.title: Attraction penalty
summary.interpretation: Positive: a mismatching distractor weakens preference for the grammatical verb.

summary.title: Matrix licensing benefit
summary.interpretation: Positive: matrix negation favors ever over often, relative to the positive control.

summary.title: Embedded negation benefit
summary.interpretation: Positive: embedded negation also favors ever; it is outside the intended licensing scope.

summary.title: Scope selectivity
summary.interpretation: Positive: matrix negation favors ever more than embedded negation does.
